messages:
elaine: Quick final check — CloudXY solution brief & partner asset pack are ready in Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/partner-assets/cloudxy/solution-brief-v3.pdf

sam (design): Downloaded. Main ask: can we get the CloudXY logo in SVG with clearspace guide? current PNG is low-res. @maria heads-up on trademark line we promised them.

maria (legal): Need explicit written consent for the customer quote on page 3. Also request to change 'powered by' -> 'built with' per their brand request. I'll draft a clause.

aj (growth): The customer metric (40% latency reduction) — do we have attribution? need a one-liner source. Also thumbs on the solution brief tone. :+1:

vijay (sales): If legal signs off today we can aim for co-launch next Tue. Can the marketplace listing use the same hero? we might need a 1920x1080 banner.

sam (design): I can make a marketplace banner and hero variants. Where should I drop assets? Proposed path: `assets/partners/cloudxy/{logo,hero,case-study}.svg`.

ops-bot: Checklist created: /checklists/partner-asset-launch — Please confirm items: logos (SVG), brand sheet, signed case study release, hi-res hero, marketplace banner.

elaine: Maria — can you post the legal clause here by EOD? Aj/Vijay — tagging for GTM alignment. Sam — please include small and large logo and monochrome.

maria (legal): Draft posted: https://docs.redwood.com/legal/cloudxy-quote-consent-draft — main points: attribution, usage duration (12 months), and co-branding approval flow. I need one more approval from partner.

aj (growth): Noted. I'll prep the marketplace blurb once assets are in S3. Also, keep the intro sentence to <= 20 words.

sam (design): Uploaded mockups to the drive folder and dropbox. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/partner-assets/cloudxy/mockups — added both color and mono logos.

elaine: Great. If no blockers, we'll freeze assets at 17:00 PST and send to partner for final sign-off. Thanks all :rocket:
